atoms.b: Debugging is the ((++process dance)) of finding and removing ((++bugs tigers)) from a computer program.
Finding bugs is the ((++first last)) part of debugging. To do this, we need to test our program to make sure we have not missed any steps or included the wrong ((++instructions animals)).

instruction.text: A program has been written that should make the robot move across to the chocolate bar. Select GO to start the program.
Which direction did the robot go?

feedback.finish: Correct! We have now found a bug in the program because the robot did not move where it was supposed to. This is a process called testing, where we test a program to check if there are any computer bugs.

instruction.text: Let’s have a look at the instructions and see where we went wrong. Select the incorrect instruction.

feedback.end: Well done! Now we have tested and found a bug, then identified what caused the bug in our code.

instruction.text: Let’s have a look at another program. This program should get the robot to the chocolate bar without meeting any scary monsters. Select GO to start the program.
Did the robot reach the chocolate bar without meeting any scary monsters?

feedback.end: Let’s have a look at the instructions to see what went wrong.

instruction.text: Listen to the statements and decide what is wrong with the instructions.

b.sound: We have used too many steps in the instructions.
We have put the steps in the wrong order.
